doNotStart.rule: Nor any other later phase. RC1 must be closed and reviewed by the operator before any of these can start.

dependencyClasses.NORMATIVE: Needs a policy choice that D-01…D-22 do not make (what is allowed, at which severity / consequence, for whom, in which claim). Closed only by a verbatim operator decision; RC1 delivers options and labelled recommendations.
dependencyClasses.ENGINEERING: The policy is decided; what remains is a representation, schema, procedure, algorithm or test design that implements it without new normative content. Closed in RC1 by specification; implementation belongs to later authorized phases.
dependencyClasses.EMPIRICAL: Can be settled only by measurement on evidence (calibration, adjudicated cases, the blind run). Closed in RC1 by a specified evidence route; stays NOT YET EMPIRICALLY VALIDATED.
dependencyClasses.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Outside RC1 (Product Contract, rubric redesign, commissioning, Dinosaur World, P9 …). Closed in RC1 by an explicit exclusion and its consequence for the RC1 claim (NOT CLAIMED / NOT IMPLEMENTED / NOT VALIDATED).

exitCriteria: Dependency register complete: every dependency of closure §10 (open and resolved) and of the ledger's openDependencies has exactly one class and one disposition with evidence, checked by a gate check

Every NORMATIVE dependency is decided by the operator (verbatim in evaluation/rc1-policy/) or explicitly deferred by the operator with its consequence for the RC1 claim; none is closed by Claude or ChatGPT
Every ENGINEERING dependency has its specification (or an exact citation of the decision that resolves it), traceable to ledger anchors
Every EMPIRICAL dependency has a specified evidence route and stays NOT YET EMPIRICALLY VALIDATED
Every OUT_OF_SCOPE dependency has an explicit exclusion and its consequence for the RC1 claim

Pre-hardening specification complete (coverage matrix, ground-truth schema + legacy projection, D-21 threshold commitment, INVALID_RUN / invalid evidence procedures, stability contract, generic tooling spec, brief specification, development corpus, validationState adaptation, Enterprise RC1 traceability including visual / cross-modal)
ChatGPT audit through the Agent Bridge with no unresolved blocking finding (or the finding escalated to the operator)
Gate PASS, brain self-tests PASS, application zero drift PASS against 866a441
Closure checkpoint brain/evidence/RC1-POLICY-DEPENDENCY-CLOSURE-CLOSURE.json; then STOP (no later phase starts without a new explicit operator authorization)
